submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 gave the highest signal efficiency at the allocated rate. At 35 GeV it reached 92.2%, against 85.9% for L3 and 74.9% for L1. For L2 alone I scanned 25, 30, 35 and 40 GeV, and efficiency peaked at 30 GeV (92.6%). The 30 GeV and 35 GeV values differ by about 0.4 points, so I treat them as roughly equal. I did not scan L1 or L3 at other thresholds. The 2025 summary agrees with the 35 GeV results.

requirements.requirement: Highest signal efficiency at allocated rate (8 kHz)
requirements.evidence: L2 at 30 GeV: 92.6%. Best of the options simulated: L2 at 35 GeV 92.2%, L3 at 35 GeV 85.9%, L1 at 35 GeV 74.9%.

candidate_specs.md says all candidates fit the FPGA resource budget (LUTs, DSPs), and links.md says the optical links have enough bandwidth. No document gives latency figures, so I could not confirm the latency budget.
